package.description: View, capture and record with a compatible Wi-Fi digital microscope on your computer.

en-US.description: View, capture and record with a compatible Wi-Fi digital microscope on your computer.
en-US.longDescription:
xploview wireless is the desktop app for compatible Wi-Fi (wireless) digital microscopes. Connect over the microscope's Wi-Fi network to view the live image on a bigger screen, capture photos, record videos, and measure details, with your captures kept close at hand on your computer.
Connection support varies by app and device; this build is intended for microscopes connected over Wi-Fi. A separate xploview app covers USB microscopes.
en-US.name: xploview wireless

zh-CN.description: 在电脑上查看、拍摄和录制兼容的 Wi-Fi 数码显微镜画面。
zh-CN.longDescription:
xploview wireless 是兼容的 Wi-Fi（无线）数码显微镜桌面应用。通过显微镜的 Wi-Fi 网络连接后，在更大的屏幕上查看实时画面，拍摄照片、录制视频并进行测量，拍摄内容就近保存在电脑上。
各应用与设备支持的连接方式有所不同；此版本适用于通过 Wi-Fi 连接的显微镜。USB 显微镜请使用单独的 xploview 应用。
